capabilities: Render Markdown notes as interconnected 3D rooms
Define rooms with ## Room headers and per-face properties
Navigate the palace with WASD, mouse wheel, and reset controls
Click WikiLinks and embedded images inside the 3D view
Configure room spacing and wall image behavior in settings
extras: The manifest description carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff."
problem: Obsidian has no way to explore notes as an immersive 3D spatial structure for memory-technique or spatial learning workflows.

relations.evidence: The plugin supports Zotflow links and Excalidraw diagrams.
The plugin supports Zotflow links and Excalidraw diagrams.

summary: 3D visualization plugin that renders Markdown notes as navigable memory palace rooms using Three.js, with clickable links and FPS-style controls.
